cohort: The study included 191 pregnant women in Nepal with singleton, full-term live births, whose data were collected from August 2018 to August 2019.
finding: Each 1 kg/week increase in GWG from the second to third trimester correlated with a 392-gram increase in birth weight, and an excessive GWG rate led to a 148-gram increase in birth weight over an adequate GWG rate.
mod_finding: Gestational weight gain rate was not significantly linked to cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Average birth weight was 2964.9 ± 407.0 grams, with 12% classified as low-birth-weight.
